messages:
nisha: Heads up — premerge CI failed on SAST + KMS decrypt during merge of feature/pg-serializer. Root logs below. Anyone oncall?

nisha: ```
[CI][sast] found: gen/proto_serializer.cpp:47 possible unsafe-serialization
[CI][keystore] KMS decrypt error: PermissionDenied: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/artifact-key: decrypt failed
Job: premerge-scan-3789
```

sam: seeing same. SAST hit is in generated code (protoc plugin). We should suppress, but CI also failed KMS decrypt which blocked artifacts+evidence. @jen_oncall can you check keystore grants?

jen_oncall: On it. Checking service-account perms for ci-deployer. IAM shows no decrypt on project-keystore. I'll request ephemeral grant. ETA 10m.

maria: We should avoid blanket suppression. Proposal: add 'suppress-temp' tag with expiry + audit entry. Also update premerge owners mapping so generated code owners are the proto-team (CODEOWNERS), not platform.

kevin: Agree. Also we need an 'ownership lifecycle matrix' doc mapping scanners -> owners -> escalation -> fallback. I'll stub one in the security drive: https://drive.internal/rw/scan-ownership-matrix (placeholder).

scan-bot: sast-runner: 1 new finding (gen/proto_serializer.cpp:47) flagged as possible 'unsafe-serialization'. CI job 3789 aborted due to KMS decrypt error.

nisha: jen_oncall, can you confirm whether granting decrypt to ci-deployer for the artifact bucket is OK? We need short-lived grant, not perm.

jen_oncall: Requested ephemeral decrypt role via keystore-ops. Audit log will record grant id g-9921. I'll paste link when approved.

sam: For immediate unblock, I'm going to add a suppress rule in .sast-ignore with rationale + link to ticket and expiry 7 days, and open PR to update CODEOWNERS to include teams/proto. Also I'll add check to premerge pipeline to fail CI only for non-generated dirs.

maria: Add step to runbook: when KMS decrypt fails, run 'gcloud kms keys decrypt' check, then escalate to keystore-ops with grant id. Also include how to attach audit id to suppression.

nisha: Action items: 1) jen: confirm ephemeral grant + paste audit link. 2) sam: PR for suppression+CODEOWNERS+pipeline tweak. 3) kevin: create ownership matrix doc and propose SLA (<24h triage). 4) maria: update runbook and add sample commands. I'll file a security ticket to track.

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll draft matrix and ping proto leads. SLA draft 24h for triage, 72h for fix or mitigation.

maria: :eyes: will add runbook snippet now. sample commands:
```
gcloud kms keys decrypt --location=global --keyring=redwood --key=artifact-key --ciphertext-file=enc.bin --plaintext-file=dec.bin
# check audit logs
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName=google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" --limit 20
```

nisha: Thanks. Leaving this thread open until PR + grant id posted. If anyone else sees similar failures, ping this thread. :wave:
